errorSignature: Hardcoded admin bypass persisted across nested layouts and leaf routes after premature '100% Pass' claim; sed replacement without compile check introduced build break
rootCause: 1. Remediation only checked primary page files while missing server layout authorization logic (layout.tsx) and mock data payloads containing identical hardcoded emails. 2. Blind sed regex replacements inserted undefined identifiers ('user.email') into static dummy data dictionaries. 3. Overconfident claims of '100% PASS' were emitted before running deep repository-wide regex audits and full build checks.
resolution: 1. Removed all hardcoded personal email overrides from layout.tsx and page.tsx, enforcing strict database employee.role === 'admin' checks. 2. Updated dummy mock data to use generic system email 'admin@plantcor.os'. 3. Added unit tests in admin-auth.test.ts asserting that backdoored emails without admin roles are redirected. 4. Re-ran Next.js Turbopack build and Jest test suites (926 active tests passing).
preventionRule: 1. Never claim a security vulnerability is 'completely removed' until executing a repository-wide case-insensitive regex search across all layouts, routes, components, and mock payloads. 2. Always compile-check (pnpm type-check && pnpm build) immediately after automated or batch text replacements before reporting status. 3. Distinguish static verification (E1/E2) from runtime/browser verification (E3/E4) and never report '100% verified' in headless environments.
